title: One Tool: the 2D knot and trade tools move onto the merged tool interface (EditTool folds into Tool), controls as a method, scene tool list replaces the terminal's package scan
description:
Repo plan phase 2.4, merge 3A.1 (the user's named example: the 2D scene tools with the 3D scene tools). The 2D abstract Tool (494 lines) carries knot hover/selection state and hit-testing against MainScene statics; the host is a static field switched by ChangeToolCommand; TradeScene dispatches with instanceof chains; keys are hard-wired KeyActions checks in MainSceneKeyGuy; there is no controls listing (InfoPane draws tool info). The merged interface keeps the name Tool (the older parent, as with Camera; EditTool folds into it) with EditTool's contract as the core (activate/deactivate, perFrame, controls method, escapePressed, frameAll, replacesView) plus what 2D tools need: overlay draw over a Camera2D, hover, info text, short/full names for the terminal ct command, confirm, toggle gating. Knot state moves into a KnotTool base for the four knot tools. Each 2D tool lists its keys in its controls method (MainSceneKeyGuy's KeyActions and RoutePlanningTool.onKeyPress become rows). Terminal.toolMap is replaced by the scene's tools list. RouteOperationStack merges into EditHistory. Knot, PointND (extends SDFCircle) and Segment (extends SDFLine) stop inheriting from renderers in the same change, since the knot tools are rewritten anyway (plain data plus drawing in the tool or scene).

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.

From ENG-28 (2026-10-17): injected and real input share one path; two tool-side issues remain for this ticket. (1) Tool.info() builds its info text once and caches it forever, so the neighbor-view and negative-cut-match tools' info pane never updates on hover (real input too); the merged tool's info() must be recomputed when hover/selection changes. (2) The TSP startup view (knotDrawLayer = -1, every layer) hit-tests nothing because MainScene's constructor sets knotDrawLayer = totalLayers before totalLayers is computed (~MainScene.java:315), and M returns to that mode; hover only works after [ or ]. What the every-layer view should hit-test is a user decision: ask before changing it. Automation check: press [ before hover in ixdar-canvas.
definition-of-done:
1. One tool interface; gui/ui/tools' abstract Tool and EditTool are one type named Tool.
2. MainScene and TradeScene host tools through Scene (activeTool, switchTool, controls listing in ctrl+I / the info pane); no instanceof tool dispatch remains.
3. Knot, PointND and Segment do not extend SDF classes.
4. TSP and trade tool behaviour unchanged; ring/region/connection/graph tools unchanged; unit suite passes.
5. Launch entries and screenshots of the TSP scene with each tool and the trade route planner.

6. Tool registry (user, 2026-10-17): @ToolAnnotation(id, host) in the annotations module, processed by RegistryProcessor into ToolRegistry_Tools (per id: a factory building the tool for its host scene, a hosted-by test, the host's name); every Tool implementation (four knot tools, two trade tools, orbit/ring/region/connection/graph) carries it; ct and ls tools resolve through it against the current scene; no package-name strings; the command, scene, geometry, mesh-node and route registries' generated sources byte-identical.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. Live: every 2D tool's keys and clicks; terminal ct; trade HQ pick and route planning; the 3D tools for regressions.
unknowns: Whether the merged interface should be named Tool (default, older parent) or EditTool.
changes-made: One Tool: ixdar.tools.EditTool folded into ixdar.tools.Tool (name kept per ruling); the 2D abstract Tool is gone. Tool keeps EditTool's contract and adds defaults for 2D hosts: displayName/shortName/desc (toolName is the ct name; fullName folded into it), info(), canUseToggle (toggle gating), drawOverlay(Camera2D, width), onHover/clearHover/onClick (called by the 2D scenes' own mouse traps until ENG-27 merges the traps), perFrame now default. KnotTool (tools/knot) holds the knot hover/selection state the four knot tools share; kept as a base rather than on MainScene because each tool resets it on activate and moves it its own way (FreeTool cycles points, MapEditor's layer keys cycle states and hover snaps to the grid, MapEditor ignores clicks); tools take their MainScene instead of MainScene.current(). MainScene/TradeScene host through Scene: tools list, activeTool/defaultTool, addToolSwitch (Ctrl+N/Ctrl+B), switchTool, Esc chain via escapePressed, frameAll (F = camera reset, new). Controls as rows: MainScene.setControls (C,B,Y,M,O,G,U,R gated on the knot-view focus by Toggle.gate, Esc), KnotTool.addControls (left/right as ControlHint.repeating rows refired every 360 ms while held, ]/up, [/down, Enter), RoutePlanningTool.addControls (P,G,C,Enter,Z,Y,Backspace; Esc cancels via escapePressed); KeyGuy.handleSceneKeys (moved up from OrbitCameraKeyGuy, which lost its own controls list) fires them, with controlSilencesPlainKeys for the editor's old Ctrl rule; 14 KeyActions constants that became rows and 9 dead ones removed; ls keys lists the scene's controls; the info pane lists the controls under the tool info. No instanceof tool dispatch: trade tools read TradeScene.hoveredCity and take onClick/onHover; State reports the route tool by identity. Info cache fixed (ENG-28): KnotTool drops infoText on every hover/selection/layer/state change, so neighbor-view and negative-cut-match info update on hover. RouteOperationStack merged into EditHistory<OperationRecord> (record pushed as both states, unlimited capacity). Tool registry (DoD 6): @ToolAnnotation(id, host) + ToolRegistry/RegistryProcessor host mode generate ToolRegistry_Tools (factory per id taking the host scene, HOSTED_BY test, HOST_NAMES); all 11 tools annotated (trade tools now take only their TradeScene); ct (multi-word names allowed) and ls tools resolve through it, refusing a tool another scene type hosts; the other registries' generated sources byte-identical to eng-25. Knot, PointND and Segment no longer extend SDFCircle/SDFLine: Drawing draws them through its shared sdfLine/circle, Drawing.strokeSegment computes the dash texture length directly; the anatomy line demos own an SDFLine. Side effects: grid lines (G) no longer throw every frame (Segment.setStroke NPE on a culled first stroke), and knot segments no longer keep stale colours from per-segment VBO caching.

Verification (baseline = eng-25 exported with git archive and built in the scratchpad): tmp/eng-26-tsp.sh on ixdar-canvas diffed against eng-25: same key consumption and tool switches; differences are fixes (info pane updates on hover, Enter in the view tools no longer throws, left/right report consumed). tmp/eng-26-trade.sh: validate-route-ops ok, route state after Z/Y/C/P/Enter/Backspace/Esc/Ctrl+Z identical; keys now report consumed. tmp/eng-26-3d-v2.sh on tmp copies of fertility_rings and crawfish_rings: mesh sha256, all tool switches and control listings, a confirmed bisector (fertility 5bb2a0af558f3140, crawfish ce0f49624801b4d1) and the regions before/after byte-identical to eng-25 (fertility sha 9b5924... and regions match ENG-23's record). mvn test: 525 run, 0 failures (BisectorTest included; new ControlRowDispatchTest). Unchanged by ruling: the every-layer startup view still hit-tests nothing until [ or ] (knotDrawLayer set before totalLayers). Behaviour notes: holding Esc no longer repeats; held keys no longer refire other held toggles; trade click records drop the toolbar-only variant; LoadMapEditor still opens a blank file that MainScene cannot load (pre-existing).
